Rising uncertainty pushed 10-year Treasury yields near their highest since January, with market-implied odds of a September Fed rate hike jumping to 66% from 41% last week. California utility stocks plunged after lawmakers rejected a measure shielding them from wildfire-related lawsuits: PG&E sank 20% and Edison International tumbled 23% on liability fears.
